description: Risk scenario rules (docs/design/sdem-requirements-risk-spec.md, RR-K05): which kind of change, to which kind of requirement in scope, raises which potential risk scenario. Governed data, not code. A rule names a scenario, the decision it needs and mitigations to consider — never a likelihood, a loss, an obligation or a target: those come only from confirmed requirements and their evidence. A confirmed breach takes the rule's breach_decision (the end state does not meet the requirement); a potential risk takes its decision.

rules.scenario: Service interruption while {changed} is migrated or changed: {requirement} may not hold during the transition, even if the end state meets it.
rules.decision: Agree a planned outage window with the requirement's owner, or require a migration without downtime.
mitigations: a cutover window agreed with the requirement's owner
a rollback plan tested before the cutover
rules.breach_decision: Choose a platform that meets the requirement, change the requirement with its owner, or accept the residual risk.

rules.scenario: Performance may change when {changed} changes: {requirement} has no evidence for the proposed architecture.
rules.decision: Require a performance test on the proposed architecture before the change goes live, or accept the risk.
mitigations: a load test on the proposed platform against the requirement's condition
monitoring of the requirement's metric through the cutover
rules.breach_decision: Meet the requirement on the proposed architecture, change it with its owner, or accept the residual risk.

rules.scenario: Where data is held or processed may change when {changed} changes: {requirement} must hold for the proposed location.
rules.decision: Confirm the proposed location meets the requirement before the change, or stop the change.
mitigations: evidence of the proposed platform's region and its replicas
a review by the requirement's owner (compliance)
rules.breach_decision: Stop the change, or choose a location that meets the requirement — a residency requirement is changed only by its owner.

rules.scenario: A capability real-time processing depends on may be missing or different on the proposed architecture: {requirement}.
rules.decision: Confirm the proposed platform provides the capability, or redesign the real-time path.
mitigations: evidence of the capability on the proposed platform
a test of the real-time path end to end
rules.breach_decision: Meet the requirement on the proposed architecture, change it with its owner, or accept the residual risk.

rules.scenario: Recovery may degrade when {changed} changes: {requirement} must hold for the proposed architecture, including its disaster-recovery set-up.
rules.decision: Require the proposed architecture's recovery set-up to meet the requirement, tested, or accept the residual risk.
mitigations: a disaster-recovery test on the proposed architecture
replication to a second region confirmed before the cutover
rules.breach_decision: Meet the requirement on the proposed architecture, change it with its owner, or accept the residual risk.

rules.scenario: {requirement} applies to records this change affects; whether it still holds after the change is not established.
rules.decision: Establish whether the requirement still holds, with evidence.
mitigations: evidence for the proposed architecture against the requirement's condition
rules.breach_decision: Meet the requirement on the proposed architecture, change it with its owner, or accept the residual risk.
